query.name: Payer Mix Report
query.query_text:
SELECT
	org.Name as 'Organization'
	,prac.Name as 'Practice'
	,pay.Name as 'Name'
	,cm.DisplayName as 'Type'
	,pay.PracticeProviderID as 'Payer-assigned Provider ID'
	,pay.Address
	,pay.City
	,pay.State
	,pay.ZipCode
	,supportsInstitutionalClaims.DisplayName as 'Accepts Institutional Claims'
	,supportsProfessionalClaims.DisplayName as 'Accepts Professional Claims'
	,supportsEligibility.DisplayName as 'Supports Eligibility'
	,supportsRemits.DisplayName as 'Supports Remits'
	,supportsClaimAttachments.DisplayName as 'Supports Claim Attachments'
	,pay.ZirMedProviderID as 'Electronic Payer ID'
	,pp.Name as 'Parent Payer'
	,CASE WHEN pay.AllowMultiYearClaims = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Allow Multi Year Claims'
	,CASE WHEN pay.IsActive = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Active'
FROM 
	Payers pay
	LEFT JOIN ParentPayers pp ON pp.ID = pay.ParentPayerID
	JOIN enum.ClaimMethod cm ON cm.ID = pay.Type
	--ughhhhhhh
	JOIN enum.PayerCapabilitySupported supportsInstitutionalClaims ON supportsInstitutionalClaims.ID = pay.SupportsInstitutionalClaims
	JOIN enum.PayerCapabilitySupported supportsProfessionalClaims ON supportsProfessionalClaims.ID = pay.SupportsProfessionalClaims
	JOIN enum.PayerCapabilitySupported supportsEligibility ON supportsEligibility.ID = pay.SupportsEligibility
	JOIN enum.PayerCapabilitySupported supportsRemits ON supportsRemits.ID = pay.SupportsRemits
	JOIN enum.PayerCapabilitySupported supportsClaimAttachments ON supportsClaimAttachments.ID = pay.SupportsClaimAttachments
	JOIN Practices prac ON prac.ID = pay.PracticeID
	JOIN Organizations org ON prac.OrganizationID = org.ID
WHERE
	prac.ID IN ('4477748A-8428-46C7-ADC2-287EF06938BA', '79408DCF-A483-4C0B-81AB-2E35A545882D')

query.name: Billed Rates Report Query
query.query_text:
SELECT top 10
	prac.Name as 'Practice'
	,fac.Name as 'Facility'
	,fac.Description as 'Description'
	,fac.NPINumber as 'NPI'
	,fac.FacilityTaxonomy as 'Taxonomy'
	,ser.Name as 'Service'
	,sbp.Name as 'Billing Profile'
	,sbpr.InstitutionalUnitRate as 'Institutional / Patient Billing Unit Rate'
	,sbp.InstitutionalRevenueCode as 'Rev Code'
	,sbp.InstitutionalHCPCSCPTCode as 'Institutional Procedure Code'
	,sr.UnitRate as 'Professional Unit Rate' --????
	,psl.HCPCSCPTCode as 'Professional Procedure Code'
	,srt.DisplayName as 'Service Rate Type'
	,(SELECT TOP 1 EffectiveDate FROM dbo.ScheduledChangeSets WHERE ObjectType = 16 AND ObjectID = sbpr.ID ORDER BY EffectiveDate DESC) as 'Effective Date'
	,CASE WHEN sbpr.IsActive = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Is Active'
	,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT ServiceRateID FROM ClaimInstanceLineItems WHERE ServiceRateID = sr.ID) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Billed'
FROM
	dbo.Practices prac
	JOIN dbo.ServiceBillingProfileReferences sbpr ON sbpr.PracticeID = prac.ID
	JOIN dbo.Facilities fac ON fac.ID = sbpr.FacilityID
	JOIN dbo.ServiceBillingProfiles sbp ON sbp.ID = sbpr.ServiceBillingProfileID
	JOIN dbo.Services ser ON ser.ID = sbpr.ServiceID
	JOIN dbo.ProfessionalServiceLines psl ON psl.ServiceBillingProfileID = sbp.ID
	JOIN dbo.ServiceRates sr ON sr.ServiceID = ser.ID
	JOIN enum.serviceratetype srt ON srt.ID = sr.Type

query.name: Payer Expected Rates Report
query.query_text:
select * into #PayerRates
from PayerRates
where PayerRates.PracticeID in ('4477748a-8428-46c7-adc2-287ef06938ba')

--grab scheduledChanges so we can fill history
Select * into #allScheduledChanges from (
SELECT 
    ObjectID,tableEffectDate , [ContractStatus],[Amount],EffectiveDate,ReviewDate
FROM  (
select * from (
SELECT ObjectID, internalscheduledChanges.EffectiveDate as 'tableEffectDate',propertyname, propertyValue 
	FROM scheduledChanges  as internalscheduledChanges
	where PracticeID in ('4477748a-8428-46c7-adc2-287ef06938ba') and propertyValue is not null and propertyValue!='') as internalOfInternal
	) AS SourceTable
PIVOT
    (MAX(propertyValue) FOR propertyname IN ([ContractStatus],[Amount],EffectiveDate,ReviewDate)) AS PivotTable
	) as ddd

	order by ObjectID,tableEffectDate desc


Select distinct 
* from 
(select 
practices.name 'Practice',
Services.name 'Service',
ServiceBillingProfiles.Name 'Billing Profile',
Payers.Name 'Payer',
#PayerRates.Amount 'Payer Rate',
LevelOfCares.Name 'Level of Care',
ServiceBillingProfiles.InstitutionalRevenueCode 'Revenue Code',
COALESCE(ServiceBillingProfiles.InstitutionalHCPCSCPTCode,ProfessionalServiceLines.HCPCSCPTCode) 'Procedure Code',
FORMAT(#PayerRates.EffectiveDate , 'd', 'en-US')  'Effective Date',
FORMAT(#PayerRates.ReviewDate , 'd', 'en-US')  'Review Date',
enum.ContractStatus.DisplayName 'Contract',
IIF(#PayerRates.IsActive=1, 'Active','Inactive') 'Status'
from #PayerRates
join practices on practices.ID = #PayerRates.PracticeID
join Payers on Payers.id = #PayerRates.PayerID
join ServiceBillingProfiles on ServiceBillingProfiles.id  = #PayerRates.ServiceBillingProfileID
join Services on Services.id = #PayerRates.serviceID
left join LevelOfCares on LevelOfCares.id = Services.LevelOfCareID
left join enum.ContractStatus on enum.ContractStatus.ID = #PayerRates.ContractStatus
OUTER APPLY
    (SELECT TOP 1 
         ProfessionalServiceLines.HCPCSCPTCode
     FROM 
         ProfessionalServiceLines 
     WHERE 
         ProfessionalServiceLines.ServiceBillingProfileID = ServiceBillingProfiles.ID
     ) ProfessionalServiceLines
Outer APPLY
	( select TOP 1 * from ScheduledChangeSets 
	where
	ScheduledChangeSets.ObjectID = #PayerRates.ID and EffectiveDate< GETDATE()
	order by EffectiveDate desc
	) ScheduledChangeSets

UNION

--Active PayerRates
select 
practices.name 'Practice',
Services.name 'Service',
ServiceBillingProfiles.Name 'Billing Profile',
Payers.Name 'Payer',
COALESCE(scheduledChanges.Amount,scheduledChangesPreviousAmount.amount) 'Payer Rate',
LevelOfCares.Name 'Level of Care',
ServiceBillingProfiles.InstitutionalRevenueCode 'Revenue Code',
COALESCE(ServiceBillingProfiles.InstitutionalHCPCSCPTCode,ProfessionalServiceLines.HCPCSCPTCode) 'Procedure Code',
Format(CAST(Coalesce(scheduledChanges.EffectiveDate,ScheduledChangeSets.effectiveDate) AS DATE) , 'd', 'en-US') 'Effective Date',
Format(CAST(COALESCE(scheduledChanges.ReviewDate,scheduledChangesPreviousReviewDate.ReviewDate) AS DATE) , 'd', 'en-US')  'Review Date',
IIF(COALESCE(scheduledChanges.ContractStatus,scheduledChangesPreviousContractStatus.ContractStatus)='NotContracted','Not Contracted', COALESCE(scheduledChanges.ContractStatus,scheduledChangesPreviousContractStatus.ContractStatus)) 'Contract',
IIF(ScheduledChangeSets.EffectiveDate>GetDate(),'Future','Historic') 'Status'
from ScheduledChangeSets
join #PayerRates on #PayerRates.ID = ScheduledChangeSets.ObjectID 
join practices on practices.ID = #PayerRates.PracticeID
join Payers on Payers.id = #PayerRates.PayerID
join ServiceBillingProfiles on ServiceBillingProfiles.id  = #PayerRates.ServiceBillingProfileID
join Services on Services.id = #PayerRates.serviceID
left join LevelOfCares on LevelOfCares.id = Services.LevelOfCareID
left join enum.ContractStatus on enum.ContractStatus.ID = #PayerRates.ContractStatus
OUTER APPLY
    (SELECT TOP 1 
         ProfessionalServiceLines.HCPCSCPTCode
     FROM 
         ProfessionalServiceLines 
     WHERE 
         ProfessionalServiceLines.ServiceBillingProfileID = ServiceBillingProfiles.ID
     ) ProfessionalServiceLines
Outer APPLY
		(
		SELECT 
		ScheduledChangeSetID, [ContractStatus],[Amount],EffectiveDate,ReviewDate
	FROM 
		(SELECT scheduledChanges.ScheduledChangeSetID, propertyname, propertyValue FROM scheduledChanges where ScheduledChangeSets.ID = scheduledChanges.scheduledChangeSetID and scheduledChanges.EffectiveDate = ScheduledChangeSets.effectiveDate) AS SourceTable
	PIVOT
		(MAX(propertyValue) FOR propertyname IN ([ContractStatus],[Amount],EffectiveDate,ReviewDate)) AS PivotTable
	) scheduledChanges
Outer APPLY
	(
	Select top 1 Amount from #allScheduledChanges
	where #allScheduledChanges.ObjectID = ScheduledChangeSets.ObjectID and Cast(#allScheduledChanges.EffectiveDate as Date)<ScheduledChangeSets.EffectiveDate and Amount is not null
	order by tableEffectDate desc
	) scheduledChangesPreviousAmount
Outer APPLY
	(
	Select top 1 ReviewDate from #allScheduledChanges
	where #allScheduledChanges.ObjectID = ScheduledChangeSets.ObjectID and Cast(#allScheduledChanges.EffectiveDate as Date)<ScheduledChangeSets.EffectiveDate and ReviewDate is not null
	order by tableEffectDate desc
	) scheduledChangesPreviousReviewDate
Outer APPLY
	(
	Select top 1 ContractStatus from #allScheduledChanges
	where #allScheduledChanges.ObjectID = ScheduledChangeSets.ObjectID and Cast(#allScheduledChanges.EffectiveDate as Date)<ScheduledChangeSets.EffectiveDate and ContractStatus is not null
	order by tableEffectDate desc
	) scheduledChangesPreviousContractStatus
) as result
order by 'Service', 'Billing Profile', 'Payer','Status','Effective Date' desc

query.name: Rendering Provider Profile Report
query.query_text:
WITH TreatmentRenderingProviders AS (
	SELECT
		RenderingProviderID
	FROM
		Treatments t
		JOIN Practices prac ON prac.ID = t.PracticeID
	WHERE
		prac.ID IN ('4477748A-8428-46C7-ADC2-287EF06938BA', '79408DCF-A483-4C0B-81AB-2E35A545882D')
		AND t.IsDeleted = 0
),
UtilizationPlanRenderingProviders AS (
	SELECT
		RenderingProviderID
	FROM
		UtilizationPlans up
		JOIN Practices prac ON prac.ID = up.PracticeID
	WHERE
		prac.ID IN ('4477748A-8428-46C7-ADC2-287EF06938BA', '79408DCF-A483-4C0B-81AB-2E35A545882D')
		AND up.IsDeleted = 0
) 

SELECT
	rp.LastName + ', ' + rp.FirstName as 'Name',
	rp.Credentials as 'Provider Credential',
	rp.NPINumber as 'NPI Number',
	rp.ProviderTaxonomy as 'Taxonomy',
	tidt.DisplayName as 'Tax Identification Number Type',
	rp.TaxIDNumber as 'Tax Identification Number',
	rp.StateLicenseNumber as 'State License Number',
	CASE WHEN rp.CanBillInsuranceAsBillingProvider = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Can Bill Insurance As Billing Provider',
	CASE WHEN rp.CanBeAssignedToAuthorizations = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Can Be Assigned To Authorizations',
	CASE WHEN rp.IsMedicaidRegisterable = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Medicaid Registerable',
	prac.Name as 'Practice',
	CASE WHEN EXISTS(
		SELECT TOP 1 
			rpref.RenderingProviderID 
		FROM
			RenderingProviderReferences rpref
			JOIN Practices prac ON prac.ID = rpref.PracticeID
		WHERE
			rpref.RenderingProviderID = rp.ID AND rpref.IsActive = 1
	) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Active (Practice)',
	CASE WHEN 
		EXISTS(
			SELECT TOP 1 
				RenderingProviderID 
			FROM
				TreatmentRenderingProviders
			WHERE
				RenderingProviderID = rp.ID
		)
	OR 
		EXISTS(
			SELECT TOP 1 
				RenderingProviderID 
			FROM
				UtilizationPlanRenderingProviders
			WHERE
				RenderingProviderID = rp.ID
		) THEN 'Yes' 
		ELSE 'No' 
	END AS 'Billed',
	(
		SELECT
			STRING_AGG(FacilityName, ', ') AS FacNames
		FROM
		(
			SELECT
				fac.Name + CASE WHEN rpref.IsActive = 1 THEN '(Active)' ELSE '(Inactive)' END AS FacilityName
			FROM 
				RenderingProviderReferences rpref
				JOIN Facilities fac ON fac.ID = rpref.FacilityID
			WHERE
				rpref.RenderingProviderID = rp.ID
		) AS FacilityNames
	) as 'Facility',
	CASE WHEN EXISTS(
		SELECT TOP 1 
			rpref.RenderingProviderID 
		FROM
			RenderingProviderReferences rpref
			JOIN Facilities fac ON fac.ID = rpref.FacilityID
		WHERE
			rpref.RenderingProviderID = rp.ID AND rpref.IsActive = 1
	) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as 'Active (Facility)'
FROM 
	RenderingProviders rp
	JOIN enum.TaxIDNumberType tidt ON tidt.ID = rp.TaxIDNumberType
	JOIN Practices prac ON prac.ID = rp.PracticeID
	JOIN Organizations org ON prac.OrganizationID = org.ID
WHERE
	prac.ID IN ('4477748A-8428-46C7-ADC2-287EF06938BA', '79408DCF-A483-4C0B-81AB-2E35A545882D')
